# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository is a developer-focused Google Cloud handbook.

When generating content:

- Explain concepts instead of copying documentation.
- Focus on understanding.
- Write in Markdown.
- Use GitHub-compatible syntax.
- Prefer Mermaid diagrams.
- Prefer tables over long paragraphs.
- Use real-world examples.
- Explain the reasoning behind every service.
- Include analogies whenever appropriate.
- Include certification notes.
- Include common mistakes.
- Compare similar services.

Never generate:

- Marketing language
- AI filler text
- Extremely long paragraphs
- Unstructured documentation

The handbook should resemble an O'Reilly technical book.
